verdicts.reason: The two candidates look pixel-identical. In both, the background has been cut into three panels with a washed-out grey centre strip and hard visible seams, so the photo no longer reads as one continuous flat-lay. The three title boxes are small and timid for the banner height, leaving dead grey space on either side of the stack. The stacked TRAVEL/MAKEUP/KIT layout is carried over from the original instead of being rearranged to read left to right as a banner should.
